name: Ranger
resourceDesc: Focus pays for every shot and comes back quickly, in a fight and out of it; the wolf asks nothing but a whistle.
identity: A bow at 25 metres and a wolf at heel: the Ranger keeps the distance, marks the quarry and lets the pack close.

branches.name: Marksman
branches.loop: Open with Aimed Shot, keep the auto-shot going with Quick Shot, bleed with Barbed Arrow, and finish low targets with a headshot.
branches.tradeoff: Everything is at range and on the player's own arrows; the wolf is a distraction, not a weapon.

nodes.name: Steady Hand
nodes.desc: Every shot hits 3% harder per rank.

nodes.name: Quick Draw
nodes.desc: Quick Shot costs 2 less Focus per rank and the auto-shot comes 5% faster per rank.

nodes.name: Piercing
nodes.desc: Aimed Shot hits 8% harder per rank against targets above 70% health.

nodes.name: Bleeding Wounds
nodes.desc: Barbed Arrow bleeds for one more tick per rank.

nodes.name: Snap Shot
nodes.desc: After an Aimed Shot the next Quick Shot is free.

nodes.name: Headshot
nodes.desc: Aimed Shot hits 12% harder per rank against targets under 35% health.

nodes.name: Double Nock
nodes.desc: Aimed Shot looses two arrows, the second at half.

nodes.name: Practised Draw
nodes.desc: Aimed Shot is drawn 0.1s quicker per rank.

branches.name: Beastbond
branches.loop: Keep the wolf fed and fierce: it takes the blows while you shoot, and Sic sends it in with a fury bite.
branches.tradeoff: The wolf is only as good as the points in it, and a Ranger who is all wolf shoots like a beginner.

nodes.name: Thick Coat
nodes.desc: Your wolf has 8% more health per rank.

nodes.name: Sharp Teeth
nodes.desc: Your wolf's bite is 10% harder per rank.

nodes.name: Mending Bond
nodes.desc: Each of your shots heals your wolf for 2% of its health per rank.

nodes.name: Sic Fury
nodes.desc: Sic's first bite lands 25% harder per rank.

nodes.name: Pack Sense
nodes.desc: Your wolf turns at once to whatever you shoot, and its first bite on it lands half again as hard.

nodes.name: Howl
nodes.desc: Your wolf's bites hold attention like a tank's blows.

nodes.name: Alpha
nodes.desc: Your wolf is an alpha: a quarter more health and bite.

nodes.name: Scarred Hide
nodes.desc: Your wolf takes 3% less per rank.

nodes.name: Shared Hunt
nodes.desc: Each of your wolf's bites gives you back 2 Focus.

branches.name: Pathfinder
branches.loop: Mark the quarry for the whole party, slow and pin what comes for you, and leap clear when it gets close.
branches.tradeoff: Control costs Focus that is not going into arrows, and a pinned target is not a dead one.

nodes.name: Fleet
nodes.desc: You move 2% faster per rank.

nodes.name: Tangling Snare
nodes.desc: Snare slows 5% more and lasts 1s longer per rank.

nodes.name: Keen Eye
nodes.desc: Hunter's Mark raises the party's damage by 2% more per rank.

nodes.name: Pin
nodes.desc: New action: an arrow through the foot that roots the target for 3s.

nodes.name: Cover of Leaves
nodes.desc: Disengage grants a barrier worth 3% of your maximum health per rank for 6s.

nodes.name: Trapper
nodes.desc: Pin holds 1s longer per rank.

nodes.name: Pathfinder
nodes.desc: Hunter's Mark also slows its target by 15%.

nodes.name: Lasting Mark
nodes.desc: Hunter's Mark lasts 3s longer per rank.

branches.name: Skirmisher
branches.loop: Open with the bow, let the wolf take the pull, then bound in with Spear Lunge, whirl the haft through the pack, feint the blow that would hurt and leap clear with Disengage.
branches.tradeoff: The Skirmisher fights at a spear's length on a Ranger's leather: every second close is a risk the Marksman never takes.

nodes.name: Long Haft
nodes.desc: Spear Lunge reaches 1m further per rank.

nodes.name: Light Step
nodes.desc: You move 1% faster per rank while an enemy is within 5m.

nodes.name: Bleeding Point
nodes.desc: Spear Lunge opens a wound that bleeds 2% of its hit a second for 6s per rank.

nodes.name: Quick Recovery
nodes.desc: Disengage comes back 1.5s sooner per rank.

nodes.name: Feint
nodes.desc: New action: Feint: a false thrust; the target's next blow at you within 3s misses.

nodes.name: Pack Tactics
nodes.desc: A foe you struck within 3s that your wolf is also on takes 3% more from the party per rank.

nodes.name: Whirl Edge
nodes.desc: Whirling Spear hits 10% harder per rank.

nodes.name: Hit and Run
nodes.desc: After Disengage, your next Spear Lunge costs no Focus.

nodes.name: Thrown Spear
nodes.desc: Out of reach, Spear Lunge throws the spear from 15m instead.

nodes.name: Catch Your Breath
nodes.desc: A kill in melee (within 5m) gives back 5 Focus per rank.

nodes.name: Dancer
nodes.desc: Feint makes one more blow miss per rank.

nodes.name: Untouchable
nodes.desc: For 4s after Whirling Spear, half of every blow at you is turned aside.
